company.name: The Saudi Investment Bank
company.shortDescription: The Saudi Investment Bank is a joint stock company that provides wholesale, retail, and commercial banking products and services.
company.description:
The Saudi Investment Bank is a joint stock company that provides wholesale, retail, and commercial banking products and services. The company arranges financing of quasi-government and private industrial sectors, and trade finance products for imports and exports. The company also established successful subsidiaries to help in investment banking and share trading, asset management, leasing, mortgages, insurance, and credit cards.

The Saudi Investment Bank was founded on 1977 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
